body.name: Joint missing-state and cross-world feasible polytope
body.construction: \(\mathcal F_{\Gamma}(H)\) is the set of nonnegative \(x=(\lambda_0,\lambda_1,q_0,q_1,\pi)\) satisfying, for every \(a\in\{0,1\}\), \(c\in\mathcal C_{+}\), \(m\in\mathcal M\), \(s,z_m,s_0,s_1\) in their declared finite state spaces, \(\sum_{s:\operatorname{pr}_m(s)=z_m}\lambda_a(c,s,m)=H_a(c,m,z_m)\), \(q_a(c,s)=\sum_m\lambda_a(c,s,m)\), \(\Gamma^{-1}r_a(m\mid c)q_a(c,s)\le\lambda_a(c,s,m)\le\Gamma r_a(m\mid c)q_a(c,s)\), \(\sum_{s_1}\pi(c,s_0,s_1)=q_0(c,s_0)\), and \(\sum_{s_0}\pi(c,s_0,s_1)=q_1(c,s_1)\). Equivalently, \(\mathcal F_{\Gamma}(H)=\{x\ge0:Ex=\bar h,\ G_{\Gamma}x\le0\}\), where \(E\) and \(G_{\Gamma}\) are the finite coefficient matrices of the displayed constraints indexed by \(\mathcal C_{+}\), \(\mathcal M\), and \(\mathcal S\). Strata in \(\mathcal C\setminus\mathcal C_{+}\) contribute zero individual-weighted mass and generate no completion, coupling, or sensitivity rows.
